verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents automations such as Incident Workflows, Event Orchestration, and AI-generated orchestration rules. The pack has no evidence of version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. The REST API versioning header concerns API response versions, not automation versioning, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
